bullets.text: Microsoft Flight Simulator Shines - Aerial firefighting missions introduced in collaboration with **New South Wales Rural Fire Service**.
Microsoft Leads AI Security - Recognized as an Overall Leader in **KuppingerCole**'s 2026 AI Security Operations Center report.
Phishing Campaigns Evolve - New multi-stage phishing tactics observed, targeting users with sophisticated social engineering.
Azure Cosmos DB Insights - Key lessons on performance optimization shared at the **Azure Cosmos DB Conf 2026**.
Windows Insider Updates - New builds and features announced, enhancing user control and experience in the **Windows Insider Program**.
AI Agent Security Expanded - **Microsoft Agent 365** now generally available, enhancing governance and security for AI agents.
Email Threat Trends - **Microsoft Threat Intelligence** reports significant phishing activity and evolving tactics in Q1 2026.
Azure IaaS Security Principles - Emphasizing defense-in-depth and secure-by-design principles for cloud infrastructure.
